name: latest-family-and-step
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/incl-production.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; GENERATOR_REV=30c4c889 MLDR_INCL_FAMILY_OUT="$tmp/family.json" bun research/mldr-incl/capture-generation.ts mldr; MLDR_INCL_FAMILY=generated DUMP_DIR="$tmp/dump" DUMP_MIN=0 DUMP_N=100000 DUMP_ALL=1 timeout -s KILL 45 bun --preload ./research/query/dump.ts --preload ./research/track-p/capture.ts research/mldr-incl/conditional-safety.ts "$tmp/family.json" 6000 no; bun research/mldr-incl/pack-capture.ts "$tmp/dump" 120000

name: integrated-base-check
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun run check; bun test core/count-recovery/member-inclusions.test.ts core/count-completion.test.ts core/count-recovery/row-demand.test.ts
